description: Specify the domain boundary where joint sets will be generated.

keywords.name: by-edges
keywords.description: List of edge IDs that define the domain boundary. The edges must be given in sequential order and form a closed polygon.

keywords.name: by-nodes
keywords.description: List of node IDs that define the external boundary of the domain. The nodes must be given in sequential order and form a closed polygon.

keywords.name: by-positions
keywords.description: List of nodal positions that define the external boundary of a domain. The positions must be given in sequential order and form a closed polygon.

keywords.name: extent
keywords.description: Specify the locations of the sides of a rectangular domain. Each set of values applies to the lower and upper bounds along x- and y-directions. If only fx1 and fx2 are provided, a square domain is used.

notes: FLAC2D only: the FLAC3D sketch rejects it.
